}}'''Metwyn''' is a [[Cairhien]]in [[Redarm]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Metwyn}}

== Appearance ==
Metwyn is a slender man with a pale face and boyish looks, though he is actually in his mid thirties. He was born in [[Cairhien]] and is known as the best swordsman among these men.

== Activities ==
In Ebou Dar he is one of the few Redarms to survive the [[gholam]] attack looking for the [[Bowl of the Winds]]. 
He then stays in the [[Tarasin Palace]] with the rest of the surviving Redarms. Mat sends him to meet him outside the city when Mat carries out his plan of escaping with the captive [[Aes Sedai]].

He meets up with Mat again outside Ebou Dar and joins [[Valan Luca]]'s Traveling Circus with the rest of Mat's group.
He is part of the group that chase [[Renna Emain]] after she stabbed [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and tries to flee to the town of [[Coramen]].
